name: Pre-Trip Preparation
examples: visas, passport renewals, travel insurance, vaccinations, medication, specialized luggage, travel gear

name: Primary Transportation
examples: round-trip flights, long-distance trains, intercity buses, ferry tickets, baggage fees, seat selection

name: Accommodation
examples: hotel rooms, hostels, vacation rental stays, resort fees, city tourism taxes, security deposits

name: Local Transportation
examples: metro/subway passes, local bus tickets, ride-hailing (uber/grab), taxis, car/scooter rentals, fuel, tolls, parking

name: Food & Dining
examples: breakfast, lunch, dinner, street food, cafes, coffee, groceries, bottled water, snacks, culinary experiences

name: Activities & Sightseeing
examples: museum tickets, historic monument passes, guided city tours, national park entries, adventure excursions, event tickets

examples: local crafts, textiles, duty-free items, regional gifts, postcards, apparel purchases

name: Connectivity & Technology
examples: local sim cards, esim data plans, portable wi-fi rentals, power adapters, replacement cables

examples: unplanned pharmacy runs, replacement toiletries, umbrellas/ponchos, printouts, unexpected baggage surcharges, emergency contingency buffer
